$doc: How the marker id is shown: the marker kind's one shape, a label put up
at a place (cell/id.json). A marker's cell is the camera grid's at its
scale, as a place's icon is, its own apart from the places' since a
marker is drawn as its own design (pxl-spec block/object.rs
`marker_cell`). Per id where the class comes to hold more than one shape.
The coarsest chunk that draws a marker: z14, where OpenMapTiles' `poi`
layer holds every point (layers/poi/poi.yaml). What someone puts up, and
what someone says, the bubble over their character, judged by the chunk
drawing where its speaker stands (pxl-kernel scene/place.rs).
A marker's cell on the camera grid, in zooms: −1 spans two of the grid's
cells, as a place's icon does.
